sanskrit: pātyagnirvipo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ pāti yahvaścaraṇaṃ sūryasya . pāti nābhā saptaśīrṣāṇamagniḥ
english: Agni guards the foremost step of the bird; the swift one guards the track of the sun. Agni guards at the navel of the seven-headed one.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ no agne payasā vasuvidrayiṃ varco dṛśe 'dāḥ
english: O Agni, you who find wealth — with milk you have granted us radiance to behold.

sanskrit: vasanta innu rantyo grīṣma innu rantyaḥ . varṣāṇyanu śarado hemantaḥ śiśira innu rantyaḥ
english: Spring is indeed delightful; summer is indeed delightful. After the rains come autumn; winter is indeed delightful; cool season is indeed delightful.

sanskrit: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt . sa bhūmiṃ sarvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam
english: The Cosmic Person has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Encompassing the earth on all sides, he extends beyond it by ten fingers.

sanskrit: tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pado 'syehābhavatpunaḥ . tathā viṣvaṅ vyakrāmadaśanānaśane abhi
english: Three-quarters of the Cosmic Person rose upward; one quarter of him was born again here. Thence he strode out in all directions over what eats and what does not eat.

sanskrit: puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam . pādo 'sya sarvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi
english: The Cosmic Person alone is all this — whatever has been and whatever shall be. He is the lord of immortality, and also of whatever grows beyond by food. All beings constitute one quarter of him; three quarters of him are the immortal in heaven.

sanskrit: tāvānasya mahimā tato jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ . utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati
english: Such is his greatness, yet greater still is the Cosmic Person. He is the lord of immortality, and of all that grows and flourishes through food.

sanskrit: tato virāḍajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ . sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ
english: From him Virāj was born; from Virāj the Cosmic Person arose. Being born, he surpassed the earth from behind and also from in front.

sanskrit: manye vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī subhojasau ye aprathethāmamitamabhi yojanam . dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ
english: I hold you two, O Heaven and Earth, as those of good nourishment, you who have spread out immeasurably and boundlessly. O Heaven and Earth, be gracious to us and release us from distress.

sanskrit: harī ta indra śmaśrūṇyuto te haritau hari . taṃ tvā stuvanti kavayaḥ puruṣāso vanargavaḥ
english: Your beard, O Indra, is tawny gold, and your two bay steeds are golden. You are praised by the poets, the sages who dwell in the woods.

sanskrit: yadvarco hiraṇyasya yadvā varco gavāmuta . satyasya brahmaṇo varcastena mā saṃ sṛjāmasi
english: Whatever brilliance gold possesses, whatever brilliance the cows possess, and the brilliance of truth and sacred prayer — with that let us be endowed.

sanskrit: sahastanna indra daddhyoja īśe hyasya mahato virapśin . kratuṃ na nṛmṇaṃ sthaviraṃ ca vājaṃ vṛtreṣu śatrūntsuhanā kṛdhī naḥ
english: He gave us strength together, O Indra; for he is master of this great power, O mighty one. Like wisdom, like manly valor and steadfast strength — make us smite our enemies among the foes.

sanskrit: saharṣabhāḥ sahavatsā udeta viśvā rūpāṇī bibhratīrdvyūdnīḥ . uruḥ pṛthurayaṃ vo astu loka imā āpaḥ suprapāṇā iha sta
english: Rise up together with your bulls, with your calves, bearing all forms, you whose udders are twofold. Let this broad wide space be yours; may these waters here be easy to drink.

sanskrit: āre bādhasva ducchunām
english: Drive away misfortune from afar.

sanskrit: vibhrāṅbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam . vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ piparti bahudhā vi rājati
english: May the resplendent, mighty one drink the sweet soma-drink, bestowing long life on the lord of the sacrifice, undivided. He who is wind-impelled, who protects the people by himself, nourishes them abundantly, and shines in many ways.

sanskrit: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ . āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca
english: The wondrous face of the gods has risen up — the eye of Mitra, Varuṇa, and Agni. He has filled heaven, earth, and the atmosphere. O Sun, you are the soul of all that moves and stands still.

sanskrit: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ . pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ
english: This dappled bull stepped forth; he sat down before his mother. Going toward his father, he entered the realm of light.

sanskrit: antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī . vyakhyanmahiṣo divam
english: Moving within, the luminous one breathes in and breathes out. The mighty bull has illumined heaven.

sanskrit: triṃṣaddhāma vi rājati vākpataṅgāya dhīyate . prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ
english: In thirty stations he shines forth; speech is offered to the bird. He responds each day with rays of light.

sanskrit: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ . sūrāya viśvacakṣase
english: Like thieves those stars depart with the darkness of night, before the all-seeing Sun.

sanskrit: adṛśrannasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ anu . bhrājanto agnayo yathā
english: His bright rays have been seen spreading among the people, blazing like fires.

sanskrit: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya . viśvamābhāsi rocanam
english: Swift, visible to all, O Sun, you are the maker of light. You illuminate the entire luminous realm.

sanskrit: pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣān . pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svardṛśe
english: You rise toward the hosts of gods; you rise toward mankind. You rise toward all the world to behold the light of heaven.

sanskrit: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ anu . tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
english: With that purifying eye of yours, O Varuṇa, you behold the active and bustling people.

sanskrit: uddyāmeṣi rajaḥ pṛthvahā mimāno aktubhiḥ . paśyañjanmāni sūrya
english: You traverse the broad realm of space, measuring out the days with your rays. O Sun, you behold all created beings.

sanskrit: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptryaḥ . tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ
english: The Sun has yoked the seven shining mares, daughters of his chariot. By them he travels, self-harnessed.

sanskrit: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya . śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇa
english: Seven bay mares carry you in your chariot, O divine Sun. O flame-haired, far-seeing one.
